remarks: Charming 4-Bedroom Cape House for Rent! Discover this well-maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom Cape-style home, perfectly situated for convenience and comfort. Featuring two bedrooms and a full bath on each level, this home offers a flexible layout ideal for families or roommates. Enjoy a nice-sized living room, ideal for relaxing and entertaining, along with the brand-new stove and fridge in a specious kitchen. The house also includes the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer and plenty of off-street parking space. Located near public transportation, shopping centers, and easy access to I-95, this home puts everything you need within reach. Don't miss out schedule a viewing today!
